context_for_next_testing_agent: Image proxy and tender enrichment features are fully working. The /api/proxy/image endpoint correctly proxies Chinese CDN images (autoimg.cn, che168.com, autohome.com) by stripping the referrer header. The getProxiedImageUrl() helper is used in DashboardOverview.js, DealCars.js, and Tenders.js to route Chinese images through the proxy. Backend get_tenders enriches tenders with real garage images by matching brand/model. The lightbox in OfferCard (Tenders.js) has full functionality: click to open, prev/next navigation, counter, dot indicators, and close button.

tender_image_enrichment.description: Matches tender brand/model against user's garage cars and replaces unsplash URLs with real garage image URLs
